card.sig_covers: compact envelope {did,schema,surface,as_of,sha256}; sha256 is the whole-card digest, so the signature binds subject, source_urls, tags, unmeasured and payload through it

number_benji_asset_usd.definition: rwa.xyz circulating asset value of the BENJI token, aggregate across the 8 public chains listed (Stellar, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche C-Chain, Polygon, Aptos, Solana)

number_fobxx_fund_usd.definition: SEC Form N-MFP3 netAssetOfSeries for Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund (series S000067043, single class C000215714), report date 2026-08-31, filed 2026-09-04, accession 0002071691-26-021281

number_platform_usd.definition: rwa.xyz platform 'Franklin Templeton Benji Investments' circulating asset value across ALL listed platform assets (includes iBENJI and other funds; not FOBXX alone)

payload.why_they_diverge: Three publishers, three scopes: token-level circulating value on public chains; fund-level net assets filed with the SEC (transfer-agent books, report date lag); platform-level total across all issuer products including other funds and iBENJI. Different definitions, not a discrepancy.
payload.daily_tracking: reconciled each publisher run from figures.json

card.subject: BENJI: three published numbers, three definitions
